svg.metadata: {"collision_pairs": [], "height_inches": 13.375, "labels": [{"rendered": "训练中的位置：算出梯度后裁剪，真正更新参数前写入学习率", "role": "text", "source": "训练中的位置：算出梯度后裁剪，真正更新参数前写入学习率"}, {"rendered": "scheduled_clip 只计算 lr、修改已有梯度并返回原范数；优化器更新仍由调用者执行。", "role": "text", "source": "scheduled_clip 只计算 lr、修改已有梯度并返回原范数；优化器更新仍由调用者执行。"}, {"rendered": "forward → loss → backward", "role": "text", "source": "forward → loss → backward"}, {"rendered": "产生／累积梯度", "role": "text", "source": "产生／累积梯度"}, {"rendered": "AMP 反缩放（使用梯度缩放时）", "role": "text", "source": "AMP 反缩放（使用梯度缩放时）"}, {"rendered": "不用梯度缩放时跳过此步", "role": "text", "source": "不用梯度缩放时跳过此步"}, {"rendered": "lr, norm = scheduled_clip(...)", "role": "text", "source": "lr, norm = scheduled_clip(...)"}, {"rendered": "只修改 .grad；参数值不变", "role": "text", "source": "只修改 .grad；参数值不变"}, {"rendered": "设置优化器学习率 → optimizer.step()", "role": "text", "source": "设置优化器学习率 → optimizer.step()"}, {"rendered": "先设置学习率，再执行参数更新", "role": "text", "source": "先设置学习率，再执行参数更新"}, {"rendered": "梯度累积：所有小批次累积完成后，再统一反缩放／裁剪；下一次累积前清梯度。", "role": "text", "source": "梯度累积：所有小批次累积完成后，再统一反缩放／裁剪；下一次累积前清梯度。"}, {"rendered": "两个计数器：本课 step=s 从 0 开始；05.05 的 AdamW step=t 从 1 开始。", "role": "text", "source": "两个计数器：本课 step=s 从 0 开始；05.05 的 AdamW step=t 从 1 开始。"}, {"rendered": "若每轮恰好更新一次，t=s+1；仅返回 lr 不会自动修改优化器的 param_groups。", "role": "text", "source": "若每轮恰好更新一次，t=s+1；仅返回 lr 不会自动修改优化器的 param_groups。"}], "language": "zh-CN", "math_engine": "XeLaTeX with unicode-math", "minimum_print_font_pt": 9.5, "name": "05-06-training-order.zh-CN", "numeric_data_sha256": "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855", "outside_labels": [], "rendered_fonts": ["STSongti-SC-Bold", "STSongti-SC-Regular", "TimesNewRomanPS-BoldMT", "TimesNewRomanPSMT"], "typography_sha256": "41d401d817f6d65a7cda1fc30c8c4be889e4d32284b5078fcf5e5e51af2166d5", "vector_pdf_sha256": "2cd86a63ff0c7899c5a926627769c80f3aeaacb86f300ef08646f68874f550a1", "width_inches": 14.0}
